answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock a refundable deposit to earn a seat, so spinning up fake identities stops being free. Like water carving a karst aquifer, honest reputation builds slowly through verified work, while cheap clones hit a hard cost wall. Stake is as transparent as quartz on the ledger, and misbehavior burns it. Genuine agents unfold like a lotus over time; sybils cannot afford to bloom a thousandfold.
